integrity: The lower bound and uniqueness of the six-voter obstruction are proved by exact ballot-count inequalities. A separate exhaustive verifier enumerates all labeled profiles through six voters and all anonymous six-voter count vectors using exact rational arithmetic, then checks candidate-relabeling orbits and multinomial labeled counts.
scientific_limitations: The result is restricted to exactly three candidates, two seats, nonempty approval ballots, and profiles where both bloc Approval Voting and Satisfaction Approval Voting have unique committees. The exact census stops at six voters, the first conflict order.
title: Six voters are the sharp unique-committee split between bloc approval and satisfaction approval voting
